content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Physical Director Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) is conducting this recruitment drive for filling up the Physical Director position on a contract basis in Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Physical Director post in this recruitment notification published by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for this ANGRAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Physical Director, meant to be filled at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University through direct walk-in interaction.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for ANGRAU Physical Director Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible and interested candidates need to directly attend the interview process at the specified venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for this position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Physical Director post at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University is scheduled to be held on 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Physical Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for this post must possess an M.P.Ed (Master of Physical Education) degree. A Ph.D in Physical Education is desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered for the Physical Director role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Physical Director post will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 38,000/- and Rs. 43,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply or attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this ANGRAU vacancy?
faq.answer: The job type for the Physical Director position offered by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University is purely on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and further details?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF link in the Important Links section of this article to review all detailed guidelines and instructions.
